about_the_game:
Step into the Role of a Healer in a Relaxing Fantasy World In this charming life-simulation game, you’ve been invited by the Adventurer’s Guild to manage a cozy infirmary in a vibrant village. Unwind as you explore lush landscapes, nurture your garden, and connect with the community at your own pace.

Create Soothing Remedies

Help adventurers recover after their journeys by crafting remedies from unique ingredients. Match reagent properties to enhance their potency, or simply enjoy the process of experimenting with new combinations.

Build Connections

Spend time getting to know your neighbors through meaningful conversations and leisurely quests. Discover their stories, form friendships, and perhaps find romance along the way.

Cultivate Your Herbal Garden

Grow a variety of herbs essential for your remedies. Tend to their individual needs, from watering to soil nutrition, and relish the calming rhythm of caring for your crops.

Explore Tranquil Biomes

Wander through diverse biomes in search of rare ingredients with unique properties. Each area has its own beauty and secrets, waiting for you to uncover them at your leisure.

Take a break from the hustle and immerse yourself in a world of healing, exploration, and connection. Your journey to becoming the village’s cherished healer begins here.
